Memory hook: “Paleo spear, Archaic atlatl, Woodland bow, Mississippian corn.”

clips.send: Europeans brought smallpox, measles and other diseases Native people had never met. Within a few years of de Soto’s visit, the powerful chiefdoms began to collapse — archaeologists see disease as a major cause. Many towns lost most of their people; survivors regrouped into the Creek and Cherokee societies of later times.

clips.send: Ocmulgee Mounds (Macon). A Clovis point found here shows Paleo hunters passed through more than 12,000 years ago. clips.send: From the late 1500s through the 1600s, Spanish Franciscan friars built missions on the islands of the Guale people — the most important was Santa Catalina de Guale on St. Catherines Island. clips.send: 16 世纪末到 17 世纪，西班牙方济各会修士在瓜莱人，Guale，的海岛上建立传教站，最重要的是圣凯瑟琳斯岛上的圣卡塔利娜·德瓜莱。原住民被要求改信天主教、为传教站和圣奥古斯丁劳动并缴纳玉米。1597 年瓜莱人起义，焚毁了传教站。1680 年，受卡罗来纳英国人武装的韦斯托人袭击后，传教站被迫南撤。
